decisions.reason: After four years, this optical spectrum connectivity service remains central to the firm's fibre-led high-bandwidth strategy, and the earlier dedicated web presence increases management's reluctance to reverse course.

The voice number ordering portal fits the firm's move toward software-defined, real-time provisioning, so accumulated development effort and strategic fit make continuation more likely than withdrawal.

Carrier pre-selection is a legacy telephony offer with weak fit to the firm's announced direction, and by now disappointing prospects are harder to attribute to temporary conditions despite some sunk-cost pressure to persist.

A direct voice network connection service still complements the firm's enterprise voice and network base, so management is likely to keep it on the market while leveraging existing customers and prior investment.
